  "title": "Social Media Lead",
  "description": "At Strivo Labs, we are passionate about helping businesses scale with speed and precision. We specialise in providing end-to-end digital solutions, from custom design and MVP development to automation and content creation.

&nbsp;Job Position: Social Media Lead&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview


	We are looking for a creative, strategic, and execution-driven Social Media Lead to lead and scale our digital presence across multiple platforms.
	This role is responsible for developing and executing high-impact social media strategies that drive brand visibility, audience engagement, community growth, and business results.
	The ideal candidate combines strong creative thinking with data-driven decision-making and has proven experience managing social media at scale.
	You will work closely with marketing, content, design, growth, and leadership teams to build compelling digital narratives and deliver consistent, high-performing campaigns across all social channels.


What You&rsquo;ll Do
Social Media Strategy &amp; Execution:


	Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with brand and business goals
	Lead content planning and platform growth strategies across Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X (Twitter), Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant platforms
	Build and maintain a strong, engaging, and consistent brand voice across all channels
	Drive audience growth, engagement, reach, and community development through innovative content and campaigns
	Create and manage social media calendars, campaign timelines, and publishing schedules


Content &amp; Campaign Management:


	Lead the development of high-performing content including short-form videos, graphics, carousels, campaigns, and thought leadership content
	Collaborate with content creators, designers, and video teams to produce platform-optimized content
	Manage campaign execution from ideation to reporting and optimization
